description.value: A nature reserve protected by Islands Trust Conservancy, also known by its Hul'qumi'num name S'ul-hween X'pey. Located in the Nanaimo area within the Islands Trust region, it is part of a network of conservation lands preserved over 31 years of partnership between the Conservancy, local organizations, and landowners.
